title: Best practices for skill creators
summary: Covers grounding skills in hands-on expertise, progressive disclosure via references/, gotchas sections, output templates, checklists, validation loops, and plan-validate-execute for agent skill authoring.
when-to-read: Read when authoring or revising an agent skill: deciding its scope, what to cut from SKILL.md, or which structural pattern (gotchas, template, checklist, validation loop) fits. Do not read for general prompt-engineering or model-selection advice unrelated to the skill-file format.
